# PainFix Physiotherapy Clinic

> PainFix Physiotherapy Clinic is an evidence-based physiotherapy and rehabilitation clinic in Multan, Punjab, Pakistan. The clinic provides manual therapy, exercise rehabilitation, sports injury treatment, pain management, post-surgical rehabilitation, stroke rehabilitation, and home physiotherapy services.

## About

PainFix Physiotherapy Clinic helps patients recover from musculoskeletal pain, injuries, mobility limitations, and neurological conditions through personalized physiotherapy programs.

Clinic Location:
Multan, Punjab, Pakistan

Services are available:
- In-clinic physiotherapy
- Home physiotherapy visits in Multan

## Conditions Treated

PainFix Physiotherapy Clinic provides rehabilitation for:

- Back pain
- Neck pain
- Sciatica
- Slip disc and disc-related pain
- Frozen shoulder
- Knee pain
- Sports injuries
- Muscle and ligament injuries
- Post-surgical recovery
- Stroke rehabilitation
- Postural problems
- Mobility limitations
